BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   B. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   D. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.
   B. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   D. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   C. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Procurement as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

7. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

8. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

11. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.

12. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   C. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Procurement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Ledger and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Trial Balance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
